source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 4 (book p. 272); the book prints no answers for Exercise 9.2; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Do \(\sin^{-1}\) angles ka farq hai aur jawab bhi \(\sin^{-1}\) mein hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\sin^{-1}\frac{12}{13}\) aur \(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}\).
Find kya karna hai? Farq \(\sin^{-1}\frac{33}{65}\) dikhana hai.
Rule kaunsa? Sine ke farq wala formula (ii), seedha.
Plan: roots nikalo, formula (ii) mein rakho, hisaab karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin^{-1}\frac{12}{13}\) aur \(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}\).
Maloom karna (prove): in ka farq \(\sin^{-1}\frac{33}{65}\) hai.
Tareeqa: formula (ii) \(\sin^{-1}x - \sin^{-1}y = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1-y^{2}} - y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right)\), jahan \(x = \frac{12}{13}\), \(y = \frac{3}{5}\). Positive \(x, y\) ke liye is ki shart \(xy \ge 0\) khud poori hai, is liye bina fikr ke laga sakte hain.

Square roots nikalein
\[\sqrt{1-x^{2}} = \sqrt{1 - \tfrac{144}{169}} = \tfrac{5}{13}\]
\[\sqrt{1-y^{2}} = \sqrt{1 - \tfrac{9}{25}} = \tfrac{4}{5}\]
Kyun: \(1 - \frac{144}{169} = \frac{25}{169}\) aur \(1 - \frac{9}{25} = \frac{16}{25}\), dono perfect squares. Yeh 5, 12, 13 aur 3, 4, 5 triples ka kamaal hai. Positive root isliye ke yeh principal angles ke cosines hain, jo pehle quadrant mein positive hote hain.

Formula (ii) lagayein
\[\text{L.H.S} = \sin^{-1}\left(\tfrac{12}{13}\cdot\tfrac{4}{5} - \tfrac{3}{5}\cdot\tfrac{5}{13}\right)\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\left(\tfrac{48}{65} - \tfrac{15}{65}\right)\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\tfrac{33}{65} = \text{R.H.S}\]
Kyun: har number ko doosre number ke root se multiply karte hain: \(x\) ke saath \(\sqrt{1-y^{2}}\), aur \(y\) ke saath \(\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\). Denominator \(13 \times 5 = 65\); numerators \(12 \times 4 = 48\) aur \(3 \times 5 = 15\); farq 33.
Dhyan dein: \(x\) ko apne hi root \(\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\) se multiply karna aam ghalti hai; jore hamesha 'cross' bante hain.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin^{-1}\tfrac{12}{13} - \sin^{-1}\tfrac{3}{5} \approx 1.1760 - 0.6435\]
\[= 0.5325\]
\[\sin^{-1}\tfrac{33}{65} \approx 0.5325\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: calculator (radian mode) dono taraf ek hi angle deta hai.
